Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with high fever and confusion

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 69-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoGluca (dose: 1 tablet twice daily).
Approximately 9 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed high fever and confusion.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
A. Duval (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter651@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
